about.title: From interfaces to products
about.paragraph1: I’m a Product Designer with 9+ years of experience across mobility, banking and digital services, designing B2B platforms, web and mobile applications.
about.paragraph2: My work spans UX/UI, user research and design systems, with a strong focus on accessibility, complex workflows and data-rich products. I bring together product thinking and strong UI craft to create experiences that are clear, consistent and built to scale.
